strategies.promptPrefix: Animate the supplied first frame as one continuous photorealistic live-action shot. Preserve its exact Character identity, wardrobe, framing and motivated light.

lookReferenceMode.promptPrefix: Create one fully photorealistic live-action take from frame one: real actors, physical materials and optical depth, never animated illustration.
lookReferenceMode.startAuthority: Image 1 governs opening composition, environment, props, pose and emotion. If drawn, use staging only: rebuild real skin, fabric and surfaces, not colorized pencil shading. Follow authored time/weather and motivated lighting.
lookReferenceMode.characterMapping: Image {imageNumber} is the approved Character Look Sheet for {roleName}, Look {lookName}. Use it only for this Character's identity and wardrobe.
lookReferenceMode.prohibitions: Do not copy a Look Sheet's multi-view layout, background, neutral pose or smile into the video. Do not swap identities or outfits between Characters or add people from sheet views. The authored performance controls expression.

strategies.promptSuffix: Use natural breathing, blinking, weight and hair/fabric inertia; real lens focus and fine sensor grain. Never transfer drawn texture, outlines or painted shading. No face reshaping, plastic skin or mechanical motion.

strategies.promptPrefix: Animate the supplied first frame as one continuous cinematic shot.
